response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software engineering across multiple languages and systems, with a strong focus on scalability and performance. However, his resume lacks direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature-flagging systems, or telemetry infrastructure, which are critical for this role. His background in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling is relevant, but his lack of explicit experimentation or growth systems experience weakens his fit.
strengths: Deep experience in scalable, high-performance systems (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering fundamentals with demonstrated ability to design systemic solutions (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq)
Proven track record of shipping production code and mentoring teams (e.g., Refactoring Dojos, CI/CD setup)
concerns: No explicit experience with experimentation platforms, feature-flagging, or telemetry infrastructure
Limited evidence of building systems that enable multiple teams to work faster (core requirement)
Lack of direct experience with AI tools for engineering velocity or experimentation quality/bias detection
